chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from one of his companions, from Salih ibn Uqba who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Eat the broad beans with their skin, for it tans (hardens/strengthens) the stomach.'
ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of eating broad beans with their skin according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) recommends consuming broad beans with their skin, noting that it 'tans' or toughens the stomach, a concept rooted in traditional humoral medicine where the skin provides necessary fiber to strengthen digestive capacity. This advice reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating practical health benefits with spiritual and physical well-being, emphasizing moderation and the therapeutic value of natural foods.
